entries.reason: It follows the round-2 structure exactly: package sidebar with counts and search, then h1, badges, a five-column Fields table, a Neighbourhood section after the fields, and a Source line naming module Person and ihris-suite-4.3.3. All four tasks are answerable on the page, and the harness visualiser is a sidebar tile plus an 'Open in the harness visualiser' link. On phones the graph becomes the Extends / Extended by / Lists referenced list and the fields become labelled cards, as the intent says.

At 1280 (h.web.png) there is no overflow (scrollWidth 1280). The field table is easy to scan, and required rows are bold 'yes'. The graph and its edge table sit side by side, so each arrow can be read as a row naming the field behind it (e.g. country via nationality, residence). Minor: in the edge table, 'extended by' wraps to two lines, and the sidebar's four-class excerpt starts at iHRIS_Person with no marker that iHRIS_NamedContact and iHRIS_Notes come before it.

At 390 (h.mobile.png) there is no overflow. The cards label every value, the Menu button and search input are at least 44px tall, and the disclosures show counts (1/2/4). But the open-menu state is still not drawn, and the package tree and visualiser tile are display:none behind it, so 'find by package' and 'reach the tile' on a phone are still assumed rather than shown. That was already noted in round 1. The body link 'Open in the harness visualiser' does keep the tile reachable.

Most of the round-1 problems are fixed: labelled <input type=search> inside role=search, real <a> nav links with aria-current, an <a> tile, <main>, a single h1 as the first heading, an SVG with role=img and a caption, a text-twin edge table, and dash patterns instead of colour. Still open: (1) on mobile, .fields td/tr are set to display:block, which can strip table semantics (flagged for A in round 1 and unchanged); (2) the .rels div has aria-label but no role, so the label is ignored; (3) there is no skip link past the sidebar, so in linear reading the h1 comes after the site title, search and about 12 nav links; (4) the decorative glyphs (circle-dash-circle in the Neighbourhood h2 and the tile, the link emoji in a summary) are not aria-hidden and will be read aloud; (5) the SVG's accessible name is the legend, not a description of the edges, which is acceptable only because the table twin sits next to it.

One candidate is justified here. decision.json records a human-owner choice between two drawn alternatives from round 1 (A catalogue-first vs B graph-and-detail, with C deferred for a stated data reason), and it keeps specific parts of each. Round 2 is scoped as a refinement with five named carry-forward fixes, so a fresh fork is not needed. The comparison stays traceable because the round-2 intent links back to it.

The nav items are <a href> elements in <nav aria-label='Packages'>, and the current page has aria-current='page'. The visualiser tile is <a class='tile' href>. The search is <form role='search'> with <label for='q'> and <input id='q' type='search'>.

Beside the SVG is a table (aria-label 'Neighbourhood edges') with the same 7 edges: 1 extends, 2 extended by, 4 draws from. Every class in it is a link (iHRIS_ManagePerson, iHRIS_QualifyPerson) except I2CE_Form, which is deliberately unlinked per fix 4, and every list is a link. On mobile the edge table is hidden along with the graph, and the relationships list is the text form there, also linked. The SVG nodes themselves are not links; the twin covers this.

The h1 'Person iHRIS_Person' is the first heading in the DOM, and the Neighbourhood h2 follows the Fields h2. It is first in reading order among headings and in <main>. It is not the first content overall, because the <aside> sidebar comes before <main> (the usual just-the-docs order). A skip link would make that complete (see accessibility).

The badge reads 'extends I2CE_Form (base class)' with a dashed border. The graph node is dashed and grey, labelled 'I2CE_Form (base)', and the legend says 'dashed: base class, no page'. The edge table shows '(base)' with no link, and the mobile list says 'base class, no page'. This is consistent with the data: no I2CE_Form record exists, and 72 records extend it. The badge's title tooltip is not reachable by keyboard, but the visible text already carries the meaning.

The sidebar note explains the difference correctly: 156 package records vs 153 distinct classes, with iHRIS_DisciplinaryAction, iHRIS_Registration and iHRIS_SalaryGrade each defined in two packages. But on mobile the note is inside the hidden nav, so a phone user sees neither the counts nor the explanation. The tile's '153 classes' also has no pointer to the note (it is next to it on web only).

notes.H: Strengths: a faithful hybrid. It keeps A's linear, just-the-docs-native class page, adds B's graph after the fields with an edge table beside it, and uses B's relationship disclosures on phones. Every fact shown is correct. Four of the five carry-forwards are fully done, and the fifth is done on web. Most important change: draw the opened mobile menu, including the package tree, the 156/153 note and the visualiser tile. That closes the last mobile gap from round 1 and makes fix 5 visible on phones. Smaller changes: a skip-to-content link; aria-hidden on the decorative glyphs; role='region' (or a real heading) for the .rels block; keep table semantics for the mobile cards (e.g. a definition list per field, or role attributes); an ellipsis or 'n before' marker on the sidebar excerpt.

factualIssues.issue: The sidebar excerpt under ihris-common shows iHRIS_Person, iHRIS_PersonCompetency, iHRIS_PersonID, iHRIS_PersonID_Type. These are the correct alphabetical run, but iHRIS_NamedContact and iHRIS_Notes come directly before iHRIS_Person, and iHRIS_PersonLanguage comes after, and nothing shows that the list is truncated at either end. Only the 'All 93' link hints at it.

The pills country, county, district and region are the forms of the form classes iHRIS_Country, iHRIS_County, iHRIS_District and iHRIS_Region (all in ihris-common). The page never names those classes, so whether a list link goes to a list page or a class page is left open.

The ihris-common count of 93 and the totals 156/153 include src/ihris-common/data-model/4.3.3/formClass.json. That record has class 'formClass', no extends and no forms, and defines one field, training_instructor, which references 'person'. It looks like a build_kg.py extraction artefact from module training-instructor, not a real class. If it is removed, the counts H shows (and the intent's) would change. H itself shows no 'referenced by' edge, which the intent does not ask for.

verified: Checked against src/ihris-common/data-model/4.3.3/iHRIS_Person.json and all of src/*/data-model/4.3.3: the six fields in order with labels (surname_ignore has a null label, shown as '(no label)'), types, required flags, and references (nationality to country; residence to country, county, district, region); extends I2CE_Form; form 'person'; definedIn ihris-common/module/Person (src/ihris-common/modules/4.3.3/Person.json exists); extended by exactly iHRIS_ManagePerson (only field: password) and iHRIS_QualifyPerson (only field: home); no I2CE_Form record, 72 records extend it; package record counts i2ce 12, ihris-common 93, ihris-manage 26, ihris-qualify 25 = 156, with 153 distinct classes; the three duplicated classes (DisciplinaryAction in qualify+manage, Registration in qualify+common, SalaryGrade in common+manage); the sidebar's alphabetical neighbours. uploads/ihris-suite-4.3.3/manifest.json has md5 398b1808ba0f4528a8c204ad7eea090a, the same as upstreamMd5, with md5MatchesUpstream true, which supports 'MD5 verified against Launchpad'. Everything H shows matches. authors.json was not opened.
